description: This file implements runtime and link-time HLSL shader code generation for 2D image textures in Direct3D, including functions for size, load, store operations, and shader variable grouping.

methods.name: image2DHLSLGroup
methods.description: Determines the image group type based on shader variable format and access mode.

methods.name: Image2DHLSLGroupSuffix
methods.description: Returns suffix string for the image group type.

methods.name: Image2DHLSLTextureString
methods.description: Constructs the texture string based on group type and texture type.

methods.name: Image2DHLSLGroupOffsetPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string for image index offset based on group type.

methods.name: Image2DHLSLGroupDeclarationPrefix
methods.description: Returns the declaration prefix string for the image group.

methods.name: Image2DHLSLGroupRegisterSuffix
methods.description: Returns the register suffix string for the image group.

methods.name: Image2DHLSLGroupFunctionName
methods.description: Generates function name string for specific image group and method.

methods.name: getImage2DGroupReturnType
methods.description: Returns the return type string for size, load, or store functions based on group and method.

methods.name: getImageMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata string for the image group.

methods.name: OutputImage2DFunctionArgumentList
methods.description: Outputs the argument list for image functions.

methods.name: OutputImage2DSizeFunction
methods.description: Generates the size function code for a given image group.

methods.name: OutputImage2DLoadFunction
methods.description: Generates the load function code for a given image group.

methods.name: OutputImage2DStoreFunction
methods.description: Generates the store function code for a given image group.

methods.name: GetImage2DRegisterIndex
methods.description: Returns the appropriate register index pointer based on group type.

methods.name: OutputHLSLImage2DUniformGroup
methods.description: Outputs shader uniform group declarations and register assignments for image variables.

methods.name: generateShaderForImage2DBindSignature
methods.description: Main function that generates the shader code for image2D binding signatures, grouping uniforms, and inserting generated functions into shader source.
